title: DungeonDodge EMI Integration
description: A mod that adds EMI integration for the DungeonDodge Server. Only for mining, and manually added, so it is not dynamic and may not be up to date.
body: A mod adding EMI integration for the DungeonDodge Server. Currently, it only includes manually added mining recipes, which may not be exhaustive. Since it is not dynamic, it might not stay up to date if server items or recipes are modified.
